name: tool_update
description:
Update the metadata of an existing tool. Scope is strictly limited to descriptions — this tool cannot change parameter types, required fields, schema structure, or tool name.

Allowed changes:
- Top-level description (what the LLM sees when selecting tools)
- Per-parameter descriptions (what the LLM sees when filling parameters)

Requires confirmation before writing. Use tool_get first to review current state and see which agents will be affected.

description.description: New top-level description for the tool. Replaces the entire current description.

parameter_descriptions.description: Map of parameter name to new description string. Only updates description fields — does not change types, required list, or any other schema property.
